training_source: Reuse the 40/10/6/6 verified planter_option/value_split game lists; independently check terrain uniqueness and actual opposite strategy name disjointness in external-opponent holdout. Use only actual Top5 acting sides, including losing sides; exclude whole games involving any Master3 family name. Preserve all NONE base choices, any attempted unaffordable/inactive slot counted as excluded. No Master3s2 action labels. Terminal outcome only for separate diagnostics, never as input.
model: Fit a three-action multinomial logit residual on a frozen v1 conditional base logit offset evaluated on the recorded elite same-seat joint action prefix. Only conditional on active, affordable base slots. NONE has a zero residual anchor; both hire classes learn their own coefficients. Equal map weighting; no class oversampling. Standardize features based only on training rows, L2 penalty 0.025, cap centered standardized inputs to [-4,+4] and logits residual to [-3,+3]. Frozen class-to-physical-action mapping NONE, RECCOLLECTOR, RECPLANTER.
diagnostic_gate: Release an actual experiment only if test_seen_pool and test_unseen_opponent average held-map conditional log loss both improve over v1 and predicted planter rate on BOTH lies no more than 0.10 above observed. Report held-out W/D/L counts, all 3 action counts, true base labels and MAP macro log loss. No threshold or feature tuning from held-out labels. Any failing gate preserves trained weights but stops the native branches.
live_safety: Intervene at most once in t8..170. Use the actual v1 legal branch and prefix, current observed status and prepared friendly commands; all other actions must agree after complete autoregressive re-decode. Reject any new landing conflict, threatened spawn, at-cap or future overdraw/overcommitment. After all planned hires and observable immediate planter expenditure keep one replacement hire in cash. Preserve the only collector/first funding path. Never increase planter recruitment in deployment given the V4 diagnosis. An eligible turn must be a conservative change toward an additional collector (from NONE or planter with at least one surviving planter), or defer a redundant planter while enough other productive workers survive. Reject delaying a collector to NONE. Require three-class softmax new top action with predicted probability >=0.50 and excess over baseline action >=0.10. If baseline observation shows no underprovided collector or excess planter/meaningful reserve deficit, stop after observational fit. Test roots based on actual packaging; do not loosen filters to get roots.
root_pool: Earliest genuine first intervention on each of six actual frozen v1 complete source histories from dev_learned and replication/learned. Root must have current commands matching the raw v1 prefix exactly, prior steps all unchanged. Pick first viable opposite-seat, distinct-terrain pair in fixed order: replication map 1 seat 0 then map 2 seat 1, followed by other opposite-seat distinct pairs ordered by source map index (replication map 1, replication map 2, first v1 dev map) and seat. Need both seats, different maps and >=2 of 6 whole trajectories with a real change; else do not run. Historical maps are previously studied. Only after fit and gate, use two paired native streams; these are local original-opponent response tests, not independent full-game victory estimates.
